Overview

About the Hot Water Generator

Unlike steam boilers, hot water generators operate at low pressure, making them safer, more energy-efficient, and easier to maintain, especially in applications where only hot water is required instead of steam.

These systems are widely used in industries such as food processing, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, hospitality, laundries, textiles, and manufacturing, where consistent and controlled hot water supply is essential for cleaning, heating, and process operations.

ART Mechatronics offers high-performance hot water generator systems, engineered for efficient heat transfer, low fuel consumption, and reliable continuous operation.

How it works

Working Principle of Hot Water Generator

Water Circulation
Water is stored and circulated in system
Heat Generation
Fuel is burned using burner system:Diesel / Gas / Oil / Biomass
Heat Transfer
Heat is transferred to water through heat exchanger or coils
Hot Water Production
Water temperature increases to required level
Distribution
Hot water is supplied to process or utility systems
Temperature Control
Controlled using sensors and control panelMaintains consistent output
